newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan June bad-cheque ratio edges up at 0.52 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan June bad-cheque ratio edges up at 0.52 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio edged up slightly higher to 0.52 percent in June from May's 0.51 percent, the central bank said on Tuesday.

The number of bad cheques accounted for 0.52 percent of all cheques written in June, with their value representing 0.29 percent of the value of all cheques issued -- the lowest level since August 1992 and down from 0.32 percent in May, the bank said.
The central bank attributed the small increase in the number of bad cheques to a booming stock market that has injected funds into listed firms.
Continuing improvement in the island's economy was helping to reduce the bad-cheque ratio, the bank said.
